# The piste: a flat snow floor 11 m wide and 25 m long (glTF z -13..12), banks rising 1.5 m over
# 2.5 m on both sides to shoulders out to x +-11. Plain snow: the game's moving pieces carry the speed.
# Only the faces the camera sees are kept. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Snow --base-color 1.000 0.965 0.827 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Piste --x-subdivisions 4 --y-subdivisions 8 --size 1 --location 0 0.5 0
scale 11 25 1
apply --scale
add mesh grid --name BankR --x-subdivisions 2 --y-subdivisions 8 --size 1 --location 6.75 0.5 0.75
scale 2.5 25 1
apply --scale
active BankR
mode edit
select vert where "pos.x > 0"
translate 0 0 0.75
select vert where "pos.x < 0"
translate 0 0 -0.75
mode object
add mesh grid --name BankL --x-subdivisions 2 --y-subdivisions 8 --size 1 --location -6.75 0.5 0.75
scale 2.5 25 1
apply --scale
active BankL
mode edit
select vert where "pos.x < 0"
translate 0 0 0.75
select vert where "pos.x > 0"
translate 0 0 -0.75
mode object
add mesh grid --name ShoulderR --x-subdivisions 2 --y-subdivisions 8 --size 1 --location 9.5 0.5 1.5
scale 3 25 1
apply --scale
add mesh grid --name ShoulderL --x-subdivisions 2 --y-subdivisions 8 --size 1 --location -9.5 0.5 1.5
scale 3 25 1
apply --scale
select all
material assign Snow
shade flat
export ground.glb
